name: Tourist eVisa

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of 35+ countries (including South Africa, Botswana, Kenya, Mauritius) enter without any advance visa documentation.

Citizens of roughly 120 countries (including the US, Canada, UK, Australia, most EU states) qualify for pay-on-arrival visas covering single entry (1 month), double entry (3 months), multiple entry (6 months), or the KAZA UniVisa for regional travel across multiple southern African countries (1 month).
requirements.fix_path: Pay the applicable visa fee on arrival, or apply via the eVisa system in advance.

requirements.blocker_text: Citizens of roughly 50 countries (including Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Nigeria, Pakistan) must obtain and pay for a visa online BEFORE travelling -- no on-arrival option. Average e-visa processing time is 7 working days; applying at least 3 weeks ahead is recommended.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for the e-visa online at least 3 weeks before travel.

sources.title: Government of Zimbabwe official eVisa portal (evisa.gov.zw) -- Category A/B/C nationality tiers, visa types including KAZA UniVisa, and processing timelines

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Zimbabwe). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct government sourcing (evisa.gov.zw, tier 1). The three-tier (A/B/C) nationality classification and the regional KAZA UniVisa (shared with Zambia, covering cross-border travel around Victoria Falls/Kavango-Zambezi transfrontier area) are both real, specific, well-documented mechanisms. Exact fees were not published on the FAQ page itself ('stated in your approval response') -- disclosed as unconfirmed rather than invented.
